decision: one page collector (paging.ts): each provider says how to read a page and where the next is; a list is complete only when the last page read says so; a page cap, an unreadable page or a page that does not say leaves it incomplete
why: completeness from the last page only, the same rule for every connector
evidence: hardening.test.ts: paging per provider, page cap

decision: Okta pages by Link header: the fetch gains an optional page() returning the next link; FakeApi routes carry next; without page() completeness is unknown
why: Okta states its next page only in a header
evidence: hardening.test.ts: two Link pages, an unreadable second page

decision: identity joins require complete lists: holders and unused per group, admins per app, leavers over accounts; otherwise read_in_part on the subject
why: a count over a partial membership list is wrong, not uncertain
evidence: hardening.test.ts: members read in part (25 of an unknown number)

decision: Okta status: only SUSPENDED and DEPROVISIONED are inactive; deprovisioned users read through the status filter
why: LOCKED_OUT and similar are live accounts; the default users list omits deprovisioned ones

decision: admins come from the provider's admin flag (Google isAdmin) as person admin_of app, or from groups that administer an app; the review is the app's
why: no group name decides who is an admin
evidence: hardening.test.ts: admin_of from isAdmin, review on app:google-workspace

decision: migration marks a fixture default as default: true and reads the renamed connector at once
why: the chain says which weight was the company's; no empty decision after a rename

decision: Slack DM imports only by the workspace's registered importers
why: a member of a shared workspace must not write an export into the engine copy

decision: fixed the steering review of PR 47: collect detects loops (a page path seen before, or a page of repeats) and counts items once by id; Drata counts distinct ids against its total, so a server returning page 1 again stays partial; the group list records its own completeness and review_overdue stays unresolved when it is partial; page-two failures tested for Linear, Jira, Vanta and Drata; a page cap tested on Vanta
why: two of the findings failed open: duplicates or a partial group list could resolve a scenario
result: VERIFIED: 447 passed, 7 expected fail; demo-check 14/14; parity 221/3/0

decision: Jira now calls /rest/api/3/search/jql, the endpoint that pages by nextPageToken and marks isLast; absolute Link URLs are followed by path
why: the old /search pairs with startAt, so real multi-page projects would always have read incomplete
evidence: hardening.test.ts: Jira by nextPageToken; absolute Link URL
